#### Learning Goals:

1. Practice working with `dplyr` and `tidyr` to manipulate and summarize statistics with grouped operations.

2. Build on our use of the `ggplot` package in `R` to customize plots using `facet_wrap()`.

::: callout-tip
Checkout [this posit learning webpage](https://posit.cloud/learn/recipes/transform/TransformI) to review computing summary statistics for groups of rows within a data frame
